title: user_message
description: Show a message to the signed-in user from the tray (Mesaj gönder, POST /api/devices/message). Sent only to an agent whose connection announced `message` in `X-Agent-Features`; for any other agent the server marks the task `Denied` with exit code -8 and sends nothing (there is no safe fallback). The agent refuses when its local `message` capability is off (`result` with `exit_code` -5 and `capability_denied` with capability `message`) and answers `result` with `exit_code` -6 and output "[REDDEDİLDİ] oturum açık kullanıcı yok" when nobody is signed in. Otherwise it shows the message and answers `result` with `exit_code` 0: right away with "[TAMAM] gösterildi"; with `requires_ack`, "[TAMAM] okundu" when the user clicks Tamam, or "[TAMAM] gösterildi, onaylanmadı" after 30 minutes without a click. A message waiting for its acknowledgement does not hold the device's task queue. See docs/agent.md#power-and-user_message-contract.

title.description: Heading, one line of plain UTF-8 text (control characters, line breaks and bidirectional formatting characters removed by the server).

text.description: Body, plain UTF-8 text. May contain line breaks (\n only; at most one empty line in a row); every other control character is removed by the server. Display it as text, never as HTML or through a shell.

style.description: info = Bilgi (neutral); warning = Uyarı (warning colour and icon).

requires_ack.description: true: keep the message up until the user clicks Tamam and report "[TAMAM] okundu" (or "[TAMAM] gösterildi, onaylanmadı" after 30 minutes).

requested_by.description: Panel user who wrote it (API tokens cannot send messages); written to the device's local audit log.
